goal: Preserve production Laravel behavior and legacy call sites while moving copied handoff artifacts to the canonical DesignApp visual contract.
visualRemediationRules: Use shared semantic tokens and the approved React component state contract.
Expose visual variant and size through explicit props; allow consumer classes for layout and spacing only.
Build stateful components with documented x-model support and ui:<component>:change events where applicable.
Use Alpine Focus for Dialog, Alert Dialog, and Sheet focus trapping and restoration.
Use Floating UI for Popover, Dropdown Menu, and Tooltip positioning.
Keep Select native and document its operating-system-rendered popup as an intentional parity exception.
Map Phosphor icons to Lucide semantics, size, weight, colour, and alignment rather than SVG path shape.
validatedFixes: Accordion icon bindings survive Blade icon-component compilation.
Stepper min/max bindings compile to executable Alpine expressions.
Switch supports documented x-model-only usage without a form name.
Calendar grid roles have valid row and cell relationships.
Decorative Separator output omits disallowed ARIA attributes.
Dropdown keyboard navigation and outside dismissal use the shared Alpine controller.
Tooltip delay and blur dismissal do not steal focus.
Dialog, Alert Dialog and Sheet close on Escape and restore trigger focus.
